statements.status_notes: Built from Debian expat 2.9.0-1 source on trixie, containing upstream UTF-16 validation fix 0cfd15bdf4b2c22d6b0df73610709dfb60921091 and regression tests 28fcfba540f6933aa8904a1514c4811713d2ab72. Runtime installed-library regression check is mandatory.

Built from Debian expat 2.9.0-1 source on trixie, containing upstream buffer-length validation fix 4d9b1c499ecb66323260a7274edcf86c5eab0517. The image build exercises the installed libexpat.so.1 and requires XML_ParseBuffer to reject oversized lengths before and after a valid parse chunk. Debian tracker: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-77214.

Debian libx11 2:1.8.12-1 rebuilt with upstream patch 6d4432b13c0b3b6a644c13de9c793a14db48d545. Patch SHA256 dd9ecf20d2ca40c7ec3d8cdf3727c729f9fae3b6cc010e9436f152ae7cd6da31 is enforced before compilation; _XkbReadKeyActions rejects out-of-range action replies.

Debian libxrender 1:0.9.12-1 rebuilt with upstream patch 0564bce5446550c1b1681f3d8a933c20ea1455f7. Patch SHA256 565e816e88ca223cebc6f833cfcfa63d20aaa22c8293d878bdd059910c4a66fc is enforced before compilation; XRenderQueryFormats rejects numSubpixel greater than numScreens.

The runtime image installs Debian's security update libbrotli1 1.1.0-2+deb13u1 (trixie-security), whose quilt series applies the upstream decoder fix da980636 (Detect-and-report-invalid-stream-earlier.patch). The installed libbrotlidec.so carries the new _ERROR_FORMAT_BLOCK_SWITCH error code, i.e. the fix is present. Trivy still reports CVE-2026-111497 as affected with no fixed version because its vulnerability DB has not yet recorded the Debian fix for this freshly published CVE; this statement asserts the installed version is fixed. Remove once Trivy's Debian data lists the fixed version. Debian tracker: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-111497.
